strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hm... looks like it worked...
No enemy movement... They don't seem to have noticed.
All right, we strike by surprise. I'm heading out.
Close in fast... right.
Wow, my heart's pounding.
The first strike wins! All hands, launch!
Here I go!
Duuuuuke Fleeeeeed!
Grendizer, go!
Hang in there, brother!
It should be around here...
No sign... of the enemy.
We did arrive late...
Couldn't they have already passed through?
But... I just contacted Nina, and she said nothing's happened on the moon...
...Which means... don't you get a really bad feeling?
Maria!?
Everyone! Hurry to the deck! Bright! ...They're coming!
An enemy attack!?
Captain, I'm launching! Everyone, hurry!
Just as Captain Gorman said. They took the bait!
Our reinforcements are on the way, but... we'll finish them off first!
Geez! That's so dirty!
Whoever can launch, engage and intercept! Hurry!
Such dirty tricks...!
Duuuuuke Fleeeeeed!
Grendizer, go!
So we're completely surrounded... Now then...
A Pinpoint Breakthrough to regroup... it's our only option, Captain?
Indeed... let's go.
Wh-what are these!?
It's the Earthlings' army! They outfoxed us!
Call HQ for backup!
Damn! I'll do it, I'll do it!
Too slow...!
Here it is!
...Wait, you're kidding, this is a hot zone!
What!? ...This ID signal... a Gundam!? ...No, it's not...?
That mobile suit...!? Is it friendly!? But... it's a Zeonic design...?
Let's see, the frequency... Captaaain! Captain Bright, can you hear me?
This is Elle Vianno, I've brought a supply unit from Anaheim!
Elle!? Is that you, Elle!?
...Elle Vianno... I see, she was with Judau...
...one of the Shangri-La Children.
Elle! That machine!?
A woman named Nina at Anaheim slipped it to me on the quiet.
Captain Bright, now that I'm here...
Nina did!?
Hey, Elle! Behind you, behind you!
Hm! Pursuers!?
Huh!? Wh-whoa! They caught up already! We'll talk later!
Do something about these guys!
She's a fun one to tease, isn't she?
Never mind that! Isn't this bad!? They're close!
Elle! You've got ammo left, right!? Go straight into combat!
Everyone else, cover Elle's unit and keep up the attack!
G-guess he still works people to the bone...
1. Destroy all enemies
1. Gerbera Tetra destroyed
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
It's over... Elle, good work.
You haven't changed a bit, Captain.
Ahem. Elle, we're free to use that mobile suit, correct?
Yup. On the quiet or not, the paperwork went through.
Something about not falling behind Nergal.
Nergal? You mean Nergal Heavy Industries?
Anaheim Electronics and Nergal Heavy Industries...
I've heard ill rumors, but any extra strength right now is welcome.
...Nina...
Oh? Something going on there?
Elle, have Roux and Judau... come back?
...I don't know. Just that they're somewhere near Jupiter...
Jupiter? Why Jupiter?
The Jupiter Energy Fleet... now that Scirocco's gone, it's the Jupitris II.
Its goal is to harvest helium-3 from Jupiter's atmosphere.
I've heard some unsettling stuff, too... so I'm worried.
Unsettling stuff?
They say the Jovian Lizards have been sighted there.
The Jovian Lizards... they're the ones rampaging on Mars, right!?
Why would they be at Jupiter!?
...Well, they do have "Jovian" in their name.
(...Jupiter, is it. Challia Bull, Paptimus Scirocco...
The Jupiter Sphere bred great Newtypes... What do they gain there?
And... what is happening there...?)
